ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--rts.title: RTS/CTS exchange with a hidden node

steps.label: same CTS overheard: C sets NAV

ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--rts.note: Every node that hears the receiver's CTS stays silent for the reserved duration, which covers the node that could not hear the sender.

ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--exp.title: hidden and exposed node side by side
rows: A to B and C to B, but A and C cannot hear each other
collision at B, both frames lost
C hears B to A, while D (C's target) is beyond B's range
B's CTS is heard by every node that could disturb B
only those nodes defer; A and C may run in parallel
ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--exp.note: A hidden node is inaudible to the sender, an exposed node is audible but harmless; the receiver's CTS separates the two cases.

ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--aod.title: AODV route discovery and first data

steps.label: RREQ rebroadcast, reverse route to S

ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--aod.note: Nothing is sent until a route is needed: the RREQ leaves reverse pointers that the RREP turns into forward routes.

ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--zrp.title: routing protocols by family
rows: proactive within k hops, reactive beyond
ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--zrp.note: Each family buys a different point on the overhead-versus-latency trade-off, and ZRP switches point by hop distance.

ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--slo.title: cwnd growth per round trip with ssthresh = 8 MSS
ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--slo.note: Doubling stops at ssthresh; from then on each round adds only one MSS, so growth becomes linear instead of exponential.

ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--odm.title: ODMRP mesh construction

steps.label: JOIN QUERY flooded: group, seq no.
JOIN REPLY, relay joins forwarding group
DATA on the mesh; refresh before expiry

ad-hoc-and-wireless-sensor-networks--odm.note: The mesh is rebuilt by periodic JOIN QUERY refreshes, so a node that stops replying simply ages out of the forwarding group.
